messages.content: Hi there! 👋 How can I help you today?
can you make me a cool budget traker in xlsx? using formulas and etc

I'll build you a sleek, formula-powered budget tracker! Let me create it now.

```python
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import DataBarRule, ColorScaleRule, FormulaRule
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, PieChart, Reference
from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation

wb = Workbook()

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────
DARK_BG      = "1A1A2E"
ACCENT_BLUE  = "0F3460"
ACCENT_TEAL  = "16C1B4"
SOFT_BG      = "F5F6FA"
WHITE        = "FFFFFF"
SUCCESS_GREEN= "2ECC71"
WARN_ORANGE  = "F39C12"
DANGER_RED   = "E74C3C"
LIGHT_BLUE   = "D6EAF8"
MID_BLUE     = "2980B9"
GREY_TEXT    = "7F8C8D"
DARK_TEXT    = "2C3E50"
CARD_BG      = "ECF0F1"

thin = Side(style="thin", color="BDC3C7")
med_border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
thick_border = Border(
    left=Side(style="medium", color=MID_BLUE),
    right=Side(style="medium", color=MID_BLUE),
    top=Side(style="medium", color=MID_BLUE),
    bottom=Side(style="medium", color=MID_BLUE),
)

def hdr_font(size=11, bold=True, color=WHITE):
    return Font(name="Segoe UI", size=size, bold=bold, color=color)

def body_font(size=10, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT):
    return Font(name="Segoe UI", size=size, bold=bold, color=color)

def center(): return Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
def left():   return Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")

def fill_row(ws, row, fill_color, start_col=1, end_col=None):
    end_col = end_col or ws.max_column
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=c).fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=fill_color)

def style_header_cell(cell, text, font_size=11, bg=ACCENT_BLUE, fg=WHITE, bold=True, width=None):
    cell.value = text
    cell.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=font_size, bold=bold, color=fg)
    cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=bg)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    cell.border = med_border

def style_body_cell(cell, value, align="left", fmt=None):
    cell.value = value
    cell.font = body_font()
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal=align, vertical="center")
    cell.border = med_border
    if fmt:
        cell.number_format = fmt


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 1 — DASHBOARD
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws_dash = wb.active
ws_dash.title = "Dashboard"
ws_dash.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_dash.column_dimensions["A"].width = 4
ws_dash.column_dimensions["B"].width = 22
ws_dash.column_dimensions["C"].width = 18
ws_dash.column_dimensions["D"].width = 18
ws_dash.column_dimensions["E"].width = 18
ws_dash.column_dimensions["F"].width = 18
ws_dash.column_dimensions["G"].width = 18
ws_dash.column_dimensions["H"].width = 18

# Title bar
ws_dash.merge_cells("B1:H1")
c = ws_dash["B1"]
c.value = "💰  BUDGET TRACKER"
c.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=20, bold=True, color=WHITE)
c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=DARK_BG)
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
ws_dash.row_dimensions[1].height = 50

ws_dash.merge_cells("B2:H2")
c2 = ws_dash["B2"]
c2.value = "Your monthly financial overview"
c2.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, color=GREY_TEXT)
c2.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=ACCENT_BLUE)
c2.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
ws_dash.row_dimensions[2].height = 22

# ── KPI Cards ──
kpis = [
    ("B", "Total Income",   "=SUM(Income!C2:C13)",     "#", SUCCESS_GREEN),
    ("C", "Total Expenses", "=SUM(Expenses!F2:F31)",   "#", DANGER_RED),
    ("D", "Net Savings",    "=B4-C4",                  "#", ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("E", "Savings Rate",   "=IF(B4=0,\"—\",C4/B4)",   "%", WARN_ORANGE),
    ("F", "Avg/Month Exp",  "=AVERAGE(Expenses!F2:F31)","#", GREY_TEXT),
    ("G", "Top Category",   '=INDEX(Expenses!B2:B31,MATCH(MAX(Expenses!F2:F31),Expenses!F2:F31,0))', "", MID_BLUE),
    ("H", "Top Spend Amt",  '=MAX(Expenses!F2:F31)',    "#", MID_BLUE),
]

for col, label, formula, prefix, color in kpis:
    r = ws_dash[f"{col}4"]
    r.value = label
    r.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, bold=False, color=GREY_TEXT)
    r.alignment = center()
    r.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=CARD_BG)
    r.border = med_border

    r2 = ws_dash[f"{col}5"]
    r2.value = formula
    r2.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=18, bold=True, color=color)
    r2.alignment = center()
    r2.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=WHITE)
    r2.border = med_border
    if prefix == "#":
        r2.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    elif prefix == "%":
        r2.number_format = '0.0%'

ws_dash.row_dimensions[4].height = 22
ws_dash.row_dimensions[5].height = 40

# ── Expense by Category chart ──
ws_dash["B8"].value = "Expense Breakdown"
ws_dash["B8"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=13, bold=True, color=DARK_TEXT)
ws_dash["B8"].alignment = left()

chart = PieChart()
chart.title = "Expenses by Category"
chart.style = 10
chart.width = 14
chart.height = 10

labels = Reference(ws_dash, ref="=Expenses!$B$2:$B$31")
values = Reference(ws_dash, ref="=Expenses!$F$2:$F$31")
chart.add_data(values, titles_from_data=False)
chart.set_categories(labels)
chart.dataLabels = showValue = True
showValue.showPercent = True
showValue.showCatName = False
showValue.showVal = False
ws_dash.add_chart(chart, "B10")

# ── Monthly comparison bar chart ──
ws_dash["N8"].value = "Income vs Expenses"
ws_dash["N8"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=13, bold=True, color=DARK_TEXT)
ws_dash["N8"].alignment = left()

bar = BarChart()
bar.type = "ColStacked"
bar.title = "Monthly Income vs Expenses"
bar.style = 10
bar.width = 16
bar.height = 10
bar.y_axis.majorTickMark = "out"
bar.x_axis.majorTickMark = "out"

data_ref = Reference(wb["Expenses"], min_col=5, max_col=6, min_row=1, max_row=13)
cats_ref = Reference(wb["Expenses"], min_col=2, max_row=13, max_col=2)
bar.add_data(data_ref, titles_from_data=True)
bar.set_categories(cats_ref)
bar.series[0].graphicalProperties.solidFill = SUCCESS_GREEN
bar.series[1].graphicalProperties.solidFill = DANGER_RED
ws_dash.add_chart(bar, "N10")

# Legend
ws_dash["B22"].value = "Income = Green  |  Expenses = Red  |  Net = Blue card above"
ws_dash["B22"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, color=GREY_TEXT)
ws_dash["B22"].alignment = left()


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 2 — INCOME
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws_inc = wb.create_sheet("Income")
ws_inc.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_inc.column_dimensions["A"].width = 4
ws_inc.column_dimensions["B"].width = 22
ws_inc.column_dimensions["C"].width = 18
ws_inc.column_dimensions["D"].width = 14
ws_inc.column_dimensions["E"].width = 14

ws_inc.merge_cells("B1:E1")
c = ws_inc["B1"]
c.value = "📥  Income"
c.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=16, bold=True, color=WHITE)
c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=DARK_BG)
c.alignment = center()
ws_inc.row_dimensions[1].height = 42

headers_inc = ["Source", "Amount", "Date", "Notes"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers_inc, 2):
    style_header_cell(ws_inc.cell(2, i, h), h, bg=ACCENT_BLUE)
ws_inc.row_dimensions[2].height = 28

# Pre-fill 12 months of income rows
income_sources = [
    "Salary / Wage", "Freelance", "Investment Returns", "Rental Income",
    "Business Profit", "Side Gig", "Refunds", "Bonus / Commission",
    "Gifts", "Interest Earned", "Other", "Tax Refund"
]
for r in range(3, 15):
    ws_inc.cell(r, 2).value = income_sources[r - 3]
    style_body_cell(ws_inc.cell(r, 3, 0), "", "center", "$#,##0.00")
    ws_inc.cell(r, 4).value = ""
    ws_inc.cell(r, 5).value = ""
    fill_row(ws_inc, r, WHITE if (r % 2 == 1) else "F8F9FA")
    ws_inc.row_dimensions[r].height = 22

# Column widths
for col in ["B","C","D","E"]:
    ws_inc.column_dimensions[col].width = 18

# Subtotal row
sub_r = 15
style_header_cell(ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 2, "TOTAL INCOME"), "TOTAL INCOME", bg=SUCCESS_GREEN, font_size=11)
ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 3).value = "=SUM(C3:C14)"
ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 3).font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=12, bold=True, color=WHITE)
ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 3).fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=SUCCESS_GREEN)
ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 3).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 3).alignment = center()
ws_inc.cell(sub_r, 3).border = med_border
for cc in [2,4,5]:
    ws_inc.cell(sub_r, cc).fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=SUCCESS_GREEN)
    ws_inc.cell(sub_r, cc).border = med_border
ws_inc.row_dimensions[sub_r].height = 30

# Data validation for notes
dv_notes = DataValidation(type="none", allow_blank=True)
ws_inc.add_data_validation(dv_notes)

# Quick instructions
ws_inc["B17"].value = "💡 Tip: Enter amounts in the Amount column. Totals update automatically."
ws_inc["B17"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, color=GREY_TEXT)


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 3 — EXPENSES
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws_exp = wb.create_sheet("Expenses")
ws_exp.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_exp.column_dimensions["A"].width = 4
ws_exp.column_dimensions["B"].width = 20
ws_exp.column_dimensions["C"].width = 16
ws_exp.column_dimensions["D"].width = 14
ws_exp.column_dimensions["E"].width = 14
ws_exp.column_dimensions["F"].width = 16
ws_exp.column_dimensions["G"].width = 20

ws_exp.merge_cells("B1:G1")
c = ws_exp["B1"]
c.value = "📤  Expenses"
c.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=16, bold=True, color=WHITE)
c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=DARK_BG)
c.alignment = center()
ws_exp.row_dimensions[1].height = 42

headers_exp = ["Category", "Description", "Budget", "Actual", "Difference", "Month", "Status"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers_exp, 2):
    style_header_cell(ws_exp.cell(2, i, h), h, bg=ACCENT_BLUE)
ws_exp.row_dimensions[2].height = 28

categories = [
    "Housing", "Utilities", "Internet / Phone", "Groceries",
    "Dining Out", "Transportation", "Fuel / Gas", "Healthcare",
    "Insurance", "Entertainment", "Shopping", "Clothing",
    "Education", "Subscriptions", "Travel", "Gifts / Donations",
    "Personal Care", "Pet Supplies", "Miscellaneous", "Savings / Investments",
    "Debt Payments", "Childcare", "Home Maintenance", "Office Supplies",
    "Fitness", "Books / Media", "Events / Tickets", "Tech / Electronics",
    "Auto / Vehicle", "Other"
]
budget_vals = [
    1500, 200, 80, 400, 150, 100, 120, 100,
    300, 80, 150, 100, 200, 30, 200, 50,
    50, 30, 100, 500, 200, 150, 100, 50,
    60, 20, 40, 100, 150, 0
]

for r in range(3, 33):
    cat = categories[r - 3]
    bud = budget_vals[r - 3]
    ws_exp.cell(r, 2).value = cat
    ws_exp.cell(r, 3, bud)

    for col, align, fmt in [(4,"center","$#,##0.00"), (5,"center","$#,##0.00"), (6,"center",""), (7,"center","")]:
        style_body_cell(ws_exp.cell(r, col, ""), align, fmt)

    diff_cell = ws_exp.cell(r, 6)
    diff_cell.value = f"=D{r}-E{r}"
    diff_cell.font = body_font(bold=True)
    diff_cell.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    diff_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
    diff_cell.border = med_border

    status_cell = ws_exp.cell(r, 7)
    status_cell.value = f'=IF(E{r}=0,"—",IF(E{r}>D{r},"⚠ Over Budget",IF(E{r}>D{r}*0.9,"🔶 Near Limit","✅ OK")))'
    status_cell.font = body_font(bold=True)
    status_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
    status_cell.border = med_border

    fill_row(ws_exp, r, WHITE if (r % 2 == 1) else "F8F9FA", 2, 7)
    ws_exp.row_dimensions[r].height = 22

# Total row
tr = 33
for cc in range(2, 8):
    c_obj = ws_exp.cell(tr, cc)
    c_obj.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=ACCENT_BLUE)
    c_obj.border = med_border
    c_obj.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=11, bold=True, color=WHITE)
    c_obj.alignment = center()
ws_exp.cell(tr, 2).value = "TOTAL"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 4).value = "=SUM(D3:D32)"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 4).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 5).value = "=SUM(E3:E32)"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 5).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 6).value = "=D33-E33"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 6).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_exp.cell(tr, 7).value = ''
ws_exp.row_dimensions[tr].height = 30

# ── Conditional formatting: over budget highlights ──
ws_exp.conditional_formatting.add(
    "F3:F32",
    FormulaRule(formula=['AND($F3<0)'], fill=PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FADBD8"))
)
ws_exp.conditional_formatting.add(
    "F3:F32",
    FormulaRule(formula=['AND($F3>=0,$F3<=0)'], fill=PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FCF3CF"))
)

# Data bars on Actual column
ws_exp.conditional_formatting.add(
    "E3:E32",
    DataBarRule(start_type='num', start_value=0, end_type='num', end_value=1000,
                color="63CADA")
)

# Data validation for Month column
dv_month = DataValidation(type="list", formula1='"Jan,Feb,Mar,Apr,May,Jun,Jul,Aug,Sep,Oct,Nov,Dec"', allow_blank=True)
ws_exp.add_data_validation(dv_month)
dv_month.add("G3:G32")

# Status icon coloring via conditional formatting
ws_exp.conditional_formatting.add(
    "G3:G32",
    FormulaRule(formula=['G3="⚠ Over Budget"'], fill=PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FADBD8"))
)
ws_exp.conditional_formatting.add(
    "G3:G32",
    FormulaRule(formula=['G3="🔶 Near Limit"'], fill=PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FCF3CF"))
)
ws_exp.conditional_formatting.add(
    "G3:G32",
    FormulaRule(formula=['G3="✅ OK"'], fill=PatternFill("solid", fgColor="D5F5E3"))
)

# Instructions
ws_exp["B35"].value = "💡 Tip: Set your Budget (Col D), enter Actual spending (Col E), pick a Month (Col G). Difference & Status auto-calculate!"
ws_exp["B35"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, color=GREY_TEXT)
ws_exp["B36"].value = "Red background = Over budget  |  Yellow = Near limit  |  Green = On track"
ws_exp["B36"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, color=GREY_TEXT)


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 4 — TRANSACTIONS LOG
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws_log = wb.create_sheet("Transactions")
ws_log.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_log.column_dimensions["A"].width = 4
ws_log.column_dimensions["B"].width = 20
ws_log.column_dimensions["C"].width = 18
ws_log.column_dimensions["D"].width = 14
ws_log.column_dimensions["E"].width = 14
ws_log.column_dimensions["F"].width = 20
ws_log.column_dimensions["G"].width = 14

ws_log.merge_cells("B1:G1")
c = ws_log["B1"]
c.value = "📒  Transaction Log"
c.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=16, bold=True, color=WHITE)
c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=DARK_BG)
c.alignment = center()
ws_log.row_dimensions[1].height = 42

headers_log = ["Date", "Description", "Category", "Type", "Amount", "Notes", "Month"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers_log, 2):
    style_header_cell(ws_log.cell(2, i, h), h, bg=ACCENT_BLUE)
ws_log.row_dimensions[2].height = 28

# Pre-fill 50 rows
for r in range(3, 53):
    ws_log.cell(r, 2).value = ""
    ws_log.cell(r, 3).value = ""
    ws_log.cell(r, 4).value = ""
    ws_log.cell(r, 5).value = ""
    ws_log.cell(r, 6).value = 0
    ws_log.cell(r, 7).value = ""
    ws_log.cell(r, 8).value = ""
    for col in range(2, 9):
        style_body_cell(ws_log.cell(r, col), ws_log.cell(r, col).value, "center" if col >= 3 else "left",
                        "$#,##0.00" if col == 6 else None)
        ws_log.cell(r, col).border = med_border
    fill_row(ws_log, r, WHITE if (r % 2 == 1) else "F8F9FA", 2, 8)
    ws_log.row_dimensions[r].height = 22

# Type dropdown
dv_type = DataValidation(type="list", formula1='"Income,Expense"', allow_blank=True)
ws_log.add_data_validation(dv_type)
dv_type.add("E3:E52")

# Category dropdown
dv_cat = DataValidation(type="list", formula1='"Housing,Utilities,Internet/Phone,Groceries,Dining Out,Transportation,Fuel/Gas,Healthcare,Insurance,Entertainment,Shopping,Clothing,Education,Subscriptions,Travel,Gifts/Donations,Personal Care,Pet Supplies,Miscellaneous,Savings/Investments,Debt Payments,Childcare,Home Maintenance,Office Supplies,Fitness,Books/Media,Events/Tickets,Tech/Electronics,Auto/Vehicle,Other"', allow_blank=True)
ws_log.add_data_validation(dv_cat)
dv_cat.add("C3:C52")

# Month dropdown
dv_month2 = DataValidation(type="list", formula1='"Jan,Feb,Mar,Apr,May,Jun,Jul,Aug,Sep,Oct,Nov,Dec"', allow_blank=True)
ws_log.add_data_validation(dv_month2)
dv_month2.add("G3:G52")

ws_log["B54"].value = "💡 Log every transaction here. Categories sync with the Expenses sheet."
ws_log["B54"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, color=GREY_TEXT)


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 5 — MONTHLY SUMMARY
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws_sum = wb.create_sheet("Monthly Summary")
ws_sum.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_sum.column_dimensions["A"].width = 4
ws_sum.column_dimensions["B"].width = 20
ws_sum.column_dimensions["C"].width = 16
ws_sum.column_dimensions["D"].width = 16
ws_sum.column_dimensions["E"].width = 16
ws_sum.column_dimensions["F"].width = 16

ws_sum.merge_cells("B1:F1")
c = ws_sum["B1"]
c.value = "📊  Monthly Summary"
c.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=16, bold=True, color=WHITE)
c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=DARK_BG)
c.alignment = center()
ws_sum.row_dimensions[1].height = 42

months = ["January","February","March","April","May","June",
          "July","August","September","October","November","December"]

headers_s = ["Month", "Income", "Expenses", "Savings", "Savings %"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers_s, 2):
    style_header_cell(ws_sum.cell(2, i, h), h, bg=ACCENT_BLUE)
ws_sum.row_dimensions[2].height = 28

for r, month in enumerate(months, 3):
    ws_sum.cell(r, 2).value = month
    style_body_cell(ws_sum.cell(r, 3), f'=SUMIF(Expenses!$G$3:$G$32,"{month}",Expenses!$D$3:$D$32)', "right", "$#,##0.00")
    style_body_cell(ws_sum.cell(r, 4), f'=SUMIF(Expenses!$G$3:$G$32,"{month}",Expenses!$E$3:$E$32)', "right", "$#,##0.00")
    style_body_cell(ws_sum.cell(r, 5), f'=C{r}-D{r}', "right", "$#,##0.00")
    style_body_cell(ws_sum.cell(r, 6), f'=IF(C{r}=0,"—",D{r}/C{r})', "right", "0.0%")
    fill_row(ws_sum, r, WHITE if (r % 2 == 1) else "F8F9FA", 2, 6)
    ws_sum.row_dimensions[r].height = 22

# Total / Average row
tr2 = 15
style_header_cell(ws_sum.cell(tr2, 2, "TOTAL / AVG"), "TOTAL / AVG", bg=ACCENT_TEAL)
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 3).value = "=SUM(C3:C14)"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 3).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 4).value = "=SUM(D3:D14)"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 4).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 5).value = "=C15-D15"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 5).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 6).value = "=IF(C15=0,\"—\",D15/C15)"
ws_sum.cell(tr2, 6).number_format = "0.0%"
for cc in range(2, 7):
    ws_sum.cell(tr2, cc).fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=ACCENT_TEAL)
    ws_sum.cell(tr2, cc).font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=11, bold=True, color=WHITE)
    ws_sum.cell(tr2, cc).alignment = center()
    ws_sum.cell(tr2, cc).border = med_border
ws_sum.row_dimensions[tr2].height = 30

ws_sum["B17"].value = "💡 Data pulls from the Expenses sheet based on the Month you select there."
ws_sum["B17"].font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=9, color=GREY_TEXT)


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 6 — GOALS
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws_goals = wb.create_sheet("Goals")
ws_goals.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_goals.column_dimensions["A"].width = 4
ws_goals.column_dimensions["B"].width = 24
ws_goals.column_dimensions["C"].width = 18
ws_goals.column_dimensions["D"].width = 18
ws_goals.column_dimensions["E"].width = 18
ws_goals.column_dimensions["F"].width = 16

ws_goals.merge_cells("B1:F1")
c = ws_goals["B1"]
c.value = "🎯  Financial Goals"
c.font = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=16, bold=True, color=WHITE)
c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=DARK_BG)

headers_g = ["Goal", "Target Amount", "Current Saved", "Progress", "Status"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers_g, 2):

]

for r, (goal, target, current) in enumerate(goals_data, 3):
```
